notes.title: Royal Alchemist's indirect sequel on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
It’s been about a year and a half since Royal Alchemist’s release, and if some of you remember the ending, you’d know that we had no intention of letting the story end there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590716/14fb1198984fd43b2940574243b4e4be97164153.png[/img]

In Royal Alchemist’s same-universe sequel [b]Royal Order[/b], you take up the role of the last remaining heir of House De Chabenet as they work to become a respected member of the High Council. With new faces and foes, players will get a chance to delve into the complex politics of magic and the wider world outside of the Kingdom of Eskia. 

Royal Order had its first demo release in November and is now coming into the final days of its [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/niftyvisuals/royal-order-a-lgbt-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]. 

We’ve received a lot of positive feedback and we’re excited to continue on with the extended demo once the campaign is over, but with your help, we can really make Royal Order the best it can be. 
We’ve passed two of our stretch goals and are on the way to partial voice acting - if you’ve ever wanted to hear Nerifiel or Beringer on your playthroughs, please consider pledging!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1749010/Royal_Order/]You can find the download to the Royal Order demo here.[/url]

[i]To a joyous venture and a happy end![/i]

notes.title: Minor Patch 1.5 & Summer Sale
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope the start of summer has been treating you guys well so far :D

We're here with a new minor patch. Version 1.5 includes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the achievement Death Master didn't get unlocked.
[*] Minor bugs with stats checks display.
[*] Multiple typo fixes (Thank you, everyone, for the reports! You guys got hawk eyes :D )
[/list]

[b]Important for Mac users![/b]
After this minor patch, you might not be able to skip old / already read text anymore. [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lhxFLAH6zc97MhpUEJ4_QVfWfto4x5WBRSFwYlWkVcc/edit]There may also be minor problems with loading saves from the middle of the scene as mentioned here.[/url]

We really, really apologize to you guys for the inconvenience. However, this time, we've made sure this doesn't happen again in the future! >_< We hope for your understanding.

At last, we're holding a small summer sale for both the game and the artbook/guide! :D
Thank you for the support. Take care everyone!

Cheers,
Nifty Visuals

notes.title: Official Guide released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590716/6b5357faead5169a53b42947a1a52763c7fed4b6.png[/img]

Hello everyone! :D

We would like to announce that the Official Guide to Royal Alchemist is now live!

[b]If you have purchased the Artbook previously and would like to upgrade to the guide, please feel free to get in touch with us! :D[/b]

The Official Guide includes all of our artbook’s content, along with in-depth character and world information; amounting up to 250 pages of content!

As the name implies, it also serves as a complete guide to the game - with hints on how to build relationships, raise different factions’ approval, and avoid deaths (or collect all of them!)

As always, thank you guys very much for the support and we wish you a nice weekend!

Cheers,
Nifty Visuals

notes.title: Royal Alchemist - Public Launch!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33590716/43ff20e79c42cfc7eb2e97bef6f3e8b76d3f407f.png[/img]

Hello everyone!  At long last, our public release is here! :D  

If you / your friend pre-ordered the game, our service provider Xsolla will send the Steam keys to your email inboxes soon! 

If you have pre-ordered the game with the artbook / guide, we will send them to you separately since you'll get the exclusive version of each. 

If there are any questions, please feel free to get in touch with us here or on Discord!  

As always, thank you guys for your support and we hope you enjoy your journey with our Royal Alchemist! :D

Cheers,
Nifty Visuals

notes.title: Extended Demo RELEASED
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33590716/e9ca12f7ea6bcb3083e0085ead9d747b4e5bdef6.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Our Extended Demo is now officially published! :D 

Please note that due to the amount of changes, saves from the old demo may not be compatible!

Here’s a quick list of changes:
[list]
[*] Additional 8000 words (Current demo length: 44k words, amounting to ~4hrs of playtime!)
[*] One new character
[*] Colored CGs
[*] Additional gender pronoun (they/them)
[*] Difficulty settings
[/list]
… among of many minor UI and gameplay updates such as the Grimoire functions, tutorials etc.!

This demo is mainly focused on polishing everything closer to our ideal goal! :D
